high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from The New Yorker magazine. The text discusses a film shot by Michael Bauman on VistaVision, a 35-mm format known for its use in classic Hollywood films such as "The Searchers" (1956) and "Vertigo" (1958). The article highlights the raw, anticlassical, guerrilla-documentary immediacy of Bauman's images, which capture migrant families crowded into pens and a protester throwing a Molotov cocktail at riot police. The camera work is described as dynamic, with the characters moving in varied and unpredictable ways.
